Documentation.long_help: Extrudes vtkPolyData as Point (shared vertices along point normals or a point vector array) or Poly (each polygon independently along its face normal, unique vertices per face). Use Selection (off by default) and a Threshold mask are independent: either, both (intersection), or neither (whole mesh). Invert flips the combined set. Output Front / Side / Back are independent: Front is the cap; Side is walls (Point: one ring on the patch boundary; Poly: every scale edge back to the original vertices); Back keeps the original selected faces (reversed when Front is also on). Point with only Front on is in-place displacement (a subset stretches neighboring faces). Creating the filter still copies the Input's active selection into the Selection widget so turning Use Selection on does not require Copy Active Selection unless the pick changed.
Documentation.short_help: SHYX Extrude: Point or Poly; Front/Side/Back; Use Selection (off by default) and Threshold independently.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseSelection
IntVectorProperty.label: Use Selection
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Off by default: the Selection port is ignored. On: restrict to the vtkSelection (independent of the Threshold mask; both on → intersection).

InputProperty.name: Selection
InputProperty.label: Selection
InputProperty.Documentation: vtkSelection used only when Use Selection is on. Independent of the Threshold mask: both on → intersection. Creating the filter copies the Input's active selection so enabling Use Selection does not require Copy Active Selection unless the pick changed.

IntVectorProperty.name: ExtrudeType
IntVectorProperty.label: Type
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Point: shared vertices along point normals (or a point vector). Poly: each face along its own face normal with unique vertices (scales / hedgehog).

IntVectorProperty.name: OutputFront
IntVectorProperty.label: Output Front
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Extruded cap. Point with Side and Back off: move existing points in place.

IntVectorProperty.name: OutputSide
IntVectorProperty.label: Output Side
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Side walls. Point: one ring on the selected patch boundary. Poly: each scale edge connects back to the original vertices (adjacent selected faces stay split).

IntVectorProperty.name: OutputBack
IntVectorProperty.label: Output Back
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Keep the original selected faces. Reversed when Output Front is also on so a closed prism has outward winding.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ExtrusionDistance
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Extrusion Distance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Signed displacement length. Optional multiplier array scales this per point (Point) or per face (Poly).

IntVectorProperty.name: FlipDirection
IntVectorProperty.label: Flip Direction
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Negate the unit direction before applying distance.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseNormalsForDirection
IntVectorProperty.label: Use Normals For Direction
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Point type: on = vtkPolyDataNormals; off = Direction Array. Ignored for Poly (face normals).

StringVectorProperty.name: DirectionArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Direction Array
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: 3-component point vector; required when Type is Point and Use Normals is off.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseDistanceMultiplierArray
IntVectorProperty.label: Use Distance Multiplier Array
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Scale Extrusion Distance by a scalar array (Point: point data; Poly: cell data if the same name exists, otherwise average of corner point values).

StringVectorProperty.name: DistanceMultiplierArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Distance Multiplier Array
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Scalar (first component) used as a per-point or per-face multiplier.

StringVectorProperty.name: MaskArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Mask Array
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Point- or cell-centered; same name on both prefers cell data. Tuple magnitude compared with Lower / Between / Upper. Independent of Use Selection: both on → intersection.

IntVectorProperty.name: ThresholdMethod
IntVectorProperty.label: Threshold Method
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: vtkThreshold-style test on the mask array: x in [Lower, Upper], x <= Lower, or x >= Upper.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: LowerThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Lower Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Used by Between and Below Lower.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: UpperThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Upper Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Used by Between and Above Upper.

IntVectorProperty.name: AllScalars
IntVectorProperty.label: All Scalars
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Point-centered mask to faces: all corners must pass vs any corner. Cell-centered mask to points: all incident cells vs any.

IntVectorProperty.name: Invert
IntVectorProperty.label: Invert
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Invert the resolved region (selection, mask, or all) before extruding.
